note: type-audit wants a pub structs FIELD tags on the STRUCT doc comment, with position qualifiers - not on the fields themselves. Tagging each bool field with its own /// type-audit: bare-ok(flag) line looks right, compiles, and FAILS the lint: worldgen:23 untagged primitive at hostility (ChannelMask). The tool audits the ITEM (the struct) and treats each field as a POSITION of that item, so the one tag line on the struct must name them: /// type-audit: bare-ok(flag: hostility), bare-ok(flag: mineral_unrest), bare-ok(flag: andosol). A tag with no position qualifier is a BLANKET verdict covering every field, which is why single-primitive fns get away with a bare bare-ok(flag). Precedent to copy: CarryingInput in domains/demography/src/carrying_capacity.rs line 12, which mixes six per-field verdicts of three different kinds on one line. A position naming no real field is a separate error (stale tag position). Also note the lint and the committed report are two different things: cargo run --manifest-path tools/type-audit/Cargo.toml -- check is in make gate, while the report at docs/audits/type-audit-report.md is a drift-checked artifact that moves on any pub-boundary change and must be regenerated in the SAME commit.
